name: BlenderNeRF Data Extraction
definition: A Blender add-on that extracts training and testing data for NeRF and Gaussian Splatting from a Blender scene. It generates render images and camera parameters (intrinsics and extrinsics) in the format expected by NeRF models (transforms_train.json/transforms_test.json).
summary: BlenderNeRF Data Extraction automates NeRF dataset generation from Blender scenes using specialized camera strategies like SOF, TTC, and COS.
